findings.sub_question: What are the limitations of a small AI model?
findings.claim: Small AI models are less accurate and slower than large cloud models.

findings.sub_question: What is the capacity of a 6GB graphics card?
findings.claim: A 6GB graphics card can handle a 3 billion parameter model in 4-bit form.

findings.sub_question: Can a small AI model run efficiently on a 6GB graphics card?
findings.claim: A small AI model can run efficiently on a 6GB graphics card if it is in 4-bit form and does not exceed the memory capacity.
